corpus._comment: Workspace-graph bench corpus — open-source, four language clusters, every lib pin taken from what its consumer actually declares (prometheus go.mod -> client_golang v1.20.5; drupal 11.1/laravel 11 -> symfony 7.2; flask 3.1.0 -> werkzeug 3.1.x; nest is a single-checkout monorepo, the D1 degenerate case). Consumers are the existing bench/repos.json pins. Workspace root is a dedicated directory reaching members by relative path (design D1 sanctioned shape).

header.bars: bench/workspace/README.md (registered 2026-08-17; the gate script reads bars from there, never from its own source)
header.gt_discipline: import-mediated plain-text extraction across member checkouts; cross-member scoped; arm-neutral
header.rung2_note: no organic bare-name cross-edges in this OSS corpus
